content.name: Rohan Deshpande
content.title: Design Head
content.summary: Design head with 16 years in advertising, brand studios and in-house consumer brands in Mumbai. Leads a 12-person design team, manages ₹1.8 crore in annual production spend, and the packaging overhaul for a snacks portfolio helped grow modern-trade sales by 23%.

experience.title: Visualiser
bullets: Created press ads, hoardings and point-of-sale material for FMCG and real estate clients.
Adapted master campaigns into Marathi, Hindi and Gujarati versions, keeping type legible in each script.
Worked on 30-plus campaign launches, many on overnight deadlines for newspaper releases.

experience.title: Senior Visualiser
bullets: Led design on identity and packaging projects for start-ups and family-run businesses moving into retail.
Managed two junior visualisers and a production artist, sharing out work and checking final artwork.
Won the studio's largest retainer of that period, a ₹45 lakh annual brand contract, after leading the pitch design.

experience.title: Lead Graphic Designer
bullets: Ran in-house design for a 70-SKU snacks and spices portfolio across general and modern trade.
Overhauled the packaging architecture with clearer flavour colour coding, followed by 23% growth in modern-trade sales.
Brought FSSAI and Legal Metrology label checks into the artwork approval flow, removing last-minute reprints.
Cut external agency spend by ₹60 lakh a year by building an in-house team of four.

experience.title: Design Head
bullets: Lead a 12-person team of designers, illustrators and motion artists working on 25 brand accounts.
Manage ₹1.8 crore in annual production spend across print, outdoor and digital campaigns.
Set up a design operations process with briefs, review stages and file standards that improved on-time delivery to 95%.
Hire and develop designers through a structured six-month programme; three team members have been promoted to leads.

education.school: Sir J.J. Institute of Applied Art

achievements.title: Packaging recognition
achievements.detail: Snacks range recognised at a national packaging awards event in 2019.

achievements.title: Visiting faculty
achievements.detail: Teach a semester module on packaging design at a Mumbai design college.
